title: Printing (physical appearance)
description: A specific physical/visual appearance of a Card in a Set: art, flavor, collector number, variant. Many printings may point at one card. Files: components/printings.json is an array of these.

card_id.description: The rules identity this printing embodies. MUST exist in cards.json.

collector_number.description: Human-readable position within the set ('042', '042a'). String, not integer — promo suffixes exist.

quantity.description: Physical copies of this printing included in the set.

art.description: Relative path to face art asset (assets/...). Omit for template-only cards.

image.description: External card scan URL (shown as the authentic printed card)

art_url.description: External URL for the RAW ARTWORK layer alone (no frame/text/border) -- what templates/layout.yaml image regions composite into the actual print-ready card. Distinct from "image" (a full composed/rendered card, kept as the original_print reference shown alongside the live render). Omit if no separate art-only asset is known; layoutCard() falls back to a tinted placeholder + artist credit when this is absent or fails to load.

background_url.description: External URL for the OFFICIAL FRAME/BORDER texture -- what templates/layout.yaml "background" regions composite full-bleed, underneath everything else. Reusable per faction+card-type (not unique per printing/card) where the source game exposes one, e.g. Arcmage's backgroundPng export. Omit if the game has no such asset; layoutCard() falls back to a flat palette tint when this is absent or fails to load.

back.description: Relative path to back art if non-default.

template_id.description: Layout template used to render this printing from card data. Omit if art is a finished full-bleed image.

provenance.description: Provenance of THIS printing's art. Falls back to game.default_provenance if omitted.
